Lake Mead Barrel Victim Identified After 40 Years

Remains discovered in a barrel at Lake Mead have been identified as a murder victim from the 1980s. The victim, who was shot in the head, was found four years ago, but his identity remained unknown until now. Las Vegas investigators have identified the man, calling it a significant piece of the puzzle in solving the case.
